name: De nuong
summary: Grilled mountain goat at a Tam Coc restaurant, on the same table as the hill goat and the crisp rice. The same name is also a goat dish in the city or the old capital.
origin: Restaurants at Tam Coc, and also the city or the old capital.
howToEat: Eat it with chanh, gừng, ớt, sả, riềng, lá sung, lá mơ, and green banana, the herbs set with the hill goat.
where: Restaurants at Tam Coc. Also named for the city or the old capital.
seoTitle: De nuong — grilled goat at Tam Coc
seoDescription: Grilled mountain goat at Tam Coc restaurants, and also a goat dish in the city or the old capital.
